facts.section: How long does it take for peptides to work?
facts.text: After you begin to use peptides you can be sure to notice a visible improvement on your skin within a few weeks. However, it may take 3-6 months of regular use for Multi-peptide serum to show its full beneficial effect.

facts.section: Do peptides have any side effects? Can we use it for the long term?
facts.text: Unlike other active skincare ingredients, peptides are usually safe to be used on all types of skin and are readily accepted by the skin’s natural metabolism. It does not show any serious side effects and has been found to be neutral on the skin. However, whenever you incorporate a new activity in your regimen, you should always patch test 48 hours before beginning to use the product.

facts.section: Is this serum safe to use every day?
facts.text: Yes. This serum is formulated with high-quality peptides that are absolutely safe to use. Peptides are building blocks of proteins and are naturally synthesized by our body. But as we age, their production reduces, hence the need for topical application arises.
